text:
Im from the Philippines. We got married also in Georgia, while I was on B1 partner visa.

We were never asked to show a marriage certificate from the Philippines.

Just an apostilled marriage certificate from where the marriage happened (Georgia)

To add - Filipino marriage in Georgia is reported to the Philippine government via the PH embassy in Ankara Turkey. Adding screenshot of guideline i received from when i got married. Your wife can reach out to PH Embassy Ankara to inquire about it
